summary: ZOOZ Strategy Ltd., a foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release announcing a 1-for-20 reverse share split of its ordinary shares, effective before market open on June 1, 2026, with trading continuing under the same symbol 'ZOOZ'. The reverse split, approved by shareholders on May 11, 2026, reduces outstanding shares from ~162M to ~8.1M. No fractional shares will be issued; fractional shares are rounded up. This capital action is a routine share consolidation, not a special situation such as a merger, tender offer, or restructuring.
